uniqueId.description: UUID of the document in Vector.

mixins.description: Active and inactive schema mixins (Entity, Document, Bill of Lading, etc.).

owner.description: Owner information including user and firm details.

status.state.description: Processing state: "idle" (ready) or "busy" (operations cannot be performed).

createdBy.description: User who created the document (entityId and displayName).

creationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was created.

modifiedBy.description: User who last modified the document.

modifiedDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was last modified.

document.address.description: Resolved address with region, locality, postalCode, streetAddress, geolocation.

document.processed.description: Whether the document has been processed.

document.uploadDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was uploaded.

document.attachments.description: Files array and aggregate PDF with download URIs.

core_documents_shipment.*.description: All fields specific to the core_documents_shipment entity (e.g., identification, carrier, weight, etc.) as shown in the example response.
